caption: The drawing features a single object, a historical dress depicted in a beige or light tan color. The dress has a square neckline, fitted bodice, and long sleeves with wide cuffs that are decorated with white lace. The front of the bodice and the skirt are extensively adorned with vertical rows of ruffles and small floral decorations in pink, green, and red hues. The wide skirt extends outwards, showing a generous amount of fabric, and is embellished with scattered clusters of floral embroidery similar to those on the bodice. The ruffles and floral embroidery follow symmetrical lines along the skirt and bodice, and the dress is shown without a wearer, positioned flat on a neutral, unadorned background.
title: Brocaded Silk Dress
